class.name: IfcFeatureElementAddition
class.brief_description: Definition from IAI : A specialization of the general feature element, that represents an existence dependent element which modifies the shape and appearance of the associated master element. The IfcFeatureElementAddition offers the ability to handle shape modifiers as semantic objects within the IFC object model that add to the shape of the master element. HISTORY New entity in Release IFC2x Edit
